label: Curriculum
intro: Every book in the course stands on the shelf at once. Select a spine to turn it face-on.
note: Only Second Year is filled in from the design mockup. Every entry marked TODO is a placeholder — replace the text, keep the shape. Fields: title (English), titleUrdu (Urdu/Arabic script, may be empty), subject, author (may be empty), description, book_size (small, medium or large — how big the book stands on the shelf; defaults to medium). Optional, for the full view a reader opens with See more: cover (path to a photograph of the book, ideally about 3:4, e.g. assets/img/books/achi-baatain.jpg — without one the binding is drawn instead) and long (a longer description; blank lines separate paragraphs; without it the description is used).
